kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستحصد (form X)
# أَسْتَحْصِدُ (ʔastaḥṣidu) /ʔas.taħ.sˤi.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْصَدَ (istaḥṣada)
# أَسْتَحْصِدَ (ʔastaḥṣida) /ʔas.taħ.sˤi.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَحْصَدَ (istaḥṣada)
# أَسْتَحْصِدْ (ʔastaḥṣid) /ʔas.taħ.sˤid/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَحْصَدَ (istaḥṣada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
